rows.en: Ymir: "...I see.
So that 'Zelbario' robbed you
of your free will?
And now you want to fight alongside us
to stop Dr. Debish's plan. Is that right?"
Leone: "Y-yes..."
Derock: "But she is Dr. Debish's daughter.
She might betray us again..."
Clovis: "For once, I agree with the big guy."
Touya: "H-hey..."
Clovis: "Leone, you're talking about turning against
your own father and sister. If they won't listen to reason,
can you fight them?"
Leone: "I... don't know...
But it's my responsibility to stop Dad and Sis.
...Even if it costs me my life.
If you really can't trust me, you can kill me here.
We've done enough to deserve that.
If it'll make you feel better..."
Rosalie: "Hey. Why won't you trust Leone?
When she helped me after that bastard Selg cornered me,
she wasn't thinking of what she could gain.
Besides, she must have been troubled too.
She was trying to talk to Touya about it."
Yamato: "Come to think of it, we saw her in the hangar then..."
Rosalie: "No one trusts someone who trusts nobody.
Leone trusted us and told us everything.
Isn't it our turn to trust her?"
Leone: "Rosalie..."
Touya: "I trust Leone.
Even if none of you do."
Fain: "Well said! I'm with Touya!
You call it betrayal, but what did Leone actually do?
She only fought us because she was being controlled."
Leone: "Thank you..."
Arthur: "...It seems we were mistaken.
There are no lies in her tears."
Clovis: "A woman's tears really are the ultimate weapon."
Leone: "Oh! I-I didn't mean to..."
Clovis: "I'm kidding. You're not the sort
who could do that, are you? Sorry I doubted you."
Leone: "No, it's..."
Xiujian: "But you should avoid publicly saying
you're Dr. Debish's daughter for a while.
People would certainly turn against you."
Ymir: "Yes... You may not like it,
but could you bear with us?"
Leone: "...Yeah. Oh, I mean, yes. Understood."
Yamato: "...I'm glad, Leone."
Leone: "Yeah... Ugh... Sniff."
Yamato: "Oh, my. You're more of a crybaby than I thought."
Leone: "B-but it's been so long
since anyone said such warm things to me..."
Yamato: "Leone..."
Gen: "Well, I was worried for a moment there,
but Sis does say something good once in a while."
Melvi: "G-Gen... You're talking too loud."
Gen: "It's fine. There's no way she can hea..."
Rosalie: "Ge-en! I can hear you perfectly well!
You could've left out 'once in a while'!"
Gen: "Oh, crap! Run, Melvi!"
Melvi: "Huh? Huh?! Whaaat?!"
Rosalie: "Wait! Hey! Leone, give me a hand!"
Leone: "Huh?! B-but..."
Touya: "Go on."
Rosalie: "Come on, hurry!"
Leone: "Y-yeah!"
Sisk: "U-um... Isn't it about time...?"
Ymir: "Huh?"
Sisk: "Oh, stop pretending you don't know...
It's almost time for the talks..."
Touya: "Talks?"
Sisk: "His Highness and General Growster of Zigrim
will be holding talks aboard Liebhofen.
Because this is no time to be fighting a war.
That's His Highness for you! He's so generous!
Oh, I wish he'd get here soon!"
Ymir: "Hee hee. Don't worry. There's no need to be so impatient."
Miyasco: "That's right. Your beloved Lord Lodis
isn't going anywhere."
Sisk: "H-honestly!"
Ymir: "Hee hee..."
Sisk: "Oh!"
Ymir: "Miyasco, please."
Rest: "Please excuse me for contacting you remotely.
I'm sorry, but would you begin the preparations?"
Sisk: "..."
Rest: "...Hm? Did I do something rude...?"
Ymir: "Oh, please don't worry about it."
Derock: "A woman's heart is complicated."
Rest: "I-I see... Anyway, please take care of it."
Ymir: "Understood."
Miyasco: "Hey, Sisk?!"
Sisk: "But..."
Miyasco: "No buts. That was rude to Rest."
Ymir: "Come on, you two. Let's go."
Sisk: "Okaaay."
Lodis: "...Am I a little early?"
Sisk: "Your Highness!♥"
Lodis: "Whoa! Sisk, stop that!"
Sisk: "Mmm... Your Highness's scent!♥"
Rest: "...She doesn't seem to be listening."
Celica: "...Derock."
Derock: "Understood. ...There we go."
Sisk: "Hey! What are you doing?! Let go of me!"
Derock: "Save that for when you're alone together.
His Majesty would prefer that too, I'm sure."
Sisk: "O-oh, right. Of course. Yes, I'll do that."
Lodis: "No, that would be a problem too..."
Baren: "...General Growster has arrived."
Ymir: "Thank you. Show him in."
Growster: "Excuse me."
Yamato: "Oh...?"
Touya: "...Huh."
Growster: "What?"
Ai: "I pictured a much bigger man..."
Aurelie: "He's kind of cute."
Growster: "What?! I-I'm leaving!"
Fores: "Y-Your Excellency!"
Growster: "Damn it, out of my way!"
Ymir: "Oh, I-I'm terribly sorry.
Honestly, you people!"
Touya: "Oh, sorry, sorry."
Ai: "Right, we didn't mean anything bad by it. Forgive us."
Aurelie: "If you fuss over little things, you'll never grow big."
Growster: "!!!!"
Ymir: "...Sigh..."
Reamond: 'Please calm down.
They simply don't understand your greatness, Your Excellency.
If you lose your temper here,
they'll question your generosity as well.
There's nothing to gain by getting angry at people
who judge only by appearances.'
Growster: "Hmm. That is true.
Hmph! I'll overlook it this time."
Reamond: "Yes... Just as I'd expect of Your Excellency.
You're a man of a different caliber from the ordinary sort."
Growster: "Of course I am! Gah ha ha!"
Reamond: (...Phew.)
Lodis: "...Shall we begin, then?"
Growster: "Yes."
Touya: "...So what happened earlier really was because
the president restarted that Code 3 project...?"
Growster: "Yes. Between him and Steinies,
how much more do they intend to sully Zigrim's glorious name?!"
Rest: "Code 3 should have been abandoned
by the previous president. If it's been restarted,
does that mean this is the current president's personal agenda?"
Growster: "Probably. But you're
well informed, aren't you?"
Rest: "I fought some of the Code 3 subjects
in the past..."
Growster: "I see. I remember now.
So that was you..."
Touya: "Hey, what's this all about?"
Rest: "I was on border patrol at the time.
I fought Armored Mechs piloted by the subjects there.
Then I struck a bargain with Zigrim
and agreed to pretend I'd seen nothing."
Touya: "A bargain?"
Rest: "A certain woman's future."
Miyasco: "..."
Sisk: "A certain woman...?"
Rest: "Well, that's..."
Miyasco: "...Me."
Celica: "What?!"
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "I'm sorry I didn't tell you.
I'm one of those subjects."
Reamond: "And so am I."
Touya: "Hey, wait a minute..."
Miyasco: "...The Human Enhancement Project, commonly called Code 3.
It was a project to take humans created through genetic manipulation
and artificially enhance them further with drugs
to produce perfect soldiers.
I too was born in a laboratory and raised there..."
Sisk: "Miyasco..."
Reamond: "That inhumane project, carried out with no regard for ethics,
was immediately halted and abandoned
by the previous president.
The direct cause was the subjects going berserk. Just five of them
wiped out two battalions. But every fact about the incident
was erased in absolute secrecy,
buried in the shadows of history."
Miyasco: "That's the incident Major Rest encountered,
and I was one of those five.
Thanks to Major Rest's kindness,
I was taken in by the Kingdom of Agarthia
and finally managed to live a normal life."
Reamond: "The military acted soon afterward and halted the project.
All of the nearly one hundred subjects sleeping in capsules
were killed, and the facility was destroyed.
I was a subject in an experiment to see how far human strength
could be enhanced while retaining individual identity. I wasn't
at the facility then, which is why I'm still alive...
This time, rather than creating people from scratch as they did us,
they seem to be using drugs
to force temporary obedience."
Miyasco: "We have to prevent that plan
from being put into action, no matter what..."
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "It's all right.
...I'm sorry I kept quiet all this time."
Sisk: "...I see... Now I understand
why you were acting strange."
Miyasco: "...I'm sorry, Sisk."
Sisk: "It's all right. However you came
into this world, you're still Miyasco.
That doesn't change the fact that we're friends."
Miyasco: "Sisk..."
Sisk: "I told you, didn't I?
'True friends never betray each other.'"
Miyasco: "Sisk... Thank you..."
Lodis: "Miyasco... Thank you for telling us.
Rest made the right decision.
If the truth about you had come out then,
people in Agarthia
would have tried to use you too. It must have been hard, and even now..."
Miyasco: "No. I have companions I can rely on,
and a true friend."
Lodis: "Heh heh... Yes, you do."
Reamond: "Cain's report will probably prompt President Horem
to speed things up."
Growster: "You don't mean he'll do that
to every soldier back home?"
Reamond: "...Probably. If we wait,
we won't be able to intervene. Perhaps now...
Fortunately, the president seems to be at his residence.
It's some distance from the city."
Fores: "An assault on the presidential residence...
One wrong step, and we'll be branded traitors."
Rest: "This is no time to worry about that.
This is a problem for the whole world."
Growster: "No, this is Zigrim's problem.
We won't ask your country for help."
Ymir: "Then how do you intend to get back?
Returning on your own would cost you a great deal of time."
Growster: "Ngh..."
Ymir: "It wouldn't take nearly so long
if we went aboard Liebhofen."
Lodis: "General Growster. This is no longer
a matter of Agarthia or Zigrim.
Ze=Ode is a concern too,
but this is more urgent.
If that plan goes fully into effect,
we'll be plunged into a futile war of attrition."
Reamond: "His Majesty King Lodis is right.
If the plan is activated, Zigrim may unite the continent...
No, the world.
But all that will remain are fields burned by war
and people's profound grief. Is there any meaning
in a victory like that?"
Fores: "Reamond! You can't speak to His Excellency like..."
Growster: "...No, it's all right. Such a victory
would indeed be meaningless. And even if we gained control for a time,
it wouldn't last long."
Lodis: "Then we have a proposal..."
Growster: "Heh. You needn't say another word.
Reluctant as I am, I'll accept your proposal."
Lodis: "I hope this handshake will last forever."
Growster: "Heh. Just as I thought."
Lodis: "?"
Growster: "That's how you truly feel.
You've been wearing the mask of a tyrant who forces war on others."
Lodis: "Heh heh... Who can say?
I might have a knife in my left hand."
Growster: "Then I will simply have misjudged you.
But I hope it won't come to that."
Lodis: "...I'll do my best."
Celica: "Brother..."
Fain: "Princess, I'm glad for you."
Celica: "...Yes."
Miyasco: "Major Rest!"
Rest: "...What's wrong?"
Miyasco: "Um... Aren't you going to see Maki?"
Rest: "Heh. She's not that weak."
Miyasco: "That's not it. Maki is..."
Rest: "Miyasco. You needn't worry.
Maki is strong. Stronger than we think."
Miyasco: "!!"
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "You don't understand anything!
Do you really love Maki?!
She truly loves you!
Truly... So much that I couldn't hope to compete..."
Rest: "...What happened?
I was told Maki's injuries weren't serious..."
Miyasco: "Maki's own injuries weren't.
But that new life, and her heart..."
Rest: "Y-you don't mean..."
Miyasco: "Maki needs you now.
Be there for her... She's in the infirmary."
Rest: "Understood. I'm sorry!"
Miyasco: "Maki... I wish you happiness..."
Rest: "Maki...!"
Maki: "Oh... R-Rest?!
Y-you could at least knock before coming in..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "Oh, don't look like that.
You're ruining that handsome face."
Rest: "...I'm sorry."
Maki: "There you go, trying to make everything your fault again...
I didn't help because you asked me to.
I helped because I wanted to.
They were truly fighting for this world."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Still, you might be a failure as a boyfriend
if you won't come save me when I'm in danger. What if I became 'damaged goods'
and couldn't get married anymore? What would you do?"
Rest: "...Then I'd take responsibility."
Maki: "Oh, there you go again..."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Huh...? Are you... serious?"
Rest: "Would I not be good enough for you after all?"
Maki: "N-no! It's not that!
I'm happy..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "Rest... There's something
I have to tell you..."
Rest: "...I know. Miyasco told me.
You've been through so much pain..."
Maki: "...Yes... I was so sad...
I couldn't stop crying. Even I thought it was strange...
I... wanted to be a mother..."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Heh heh... That hurts..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "...I have to live...
I have to live a full life for that child too...
...Don't I, Rest...?"
Rest: "Yes..."
Tix: "...Huh? Why am I... here...?
Beyond here is the Chamber of Sealing... The place that protects the 'Guardian'..."
Tix: "...What is it? It feels familiar...
but a little different somehow..."
Tix: "That's... an Armored Mech...?
No, it's something else..."
Tix: "...Wh-who's there?!"
?????: "...Hello. It's been a while, Tix."
Tix: "C-could it be... Big Brother... Rayfon?"
Ymir: "...Miyasco, how is it going?"
Miyasco: "No good. He won't listen to us.
Lord Lodis is negotiating with him now, but..."
Celica: "It'll probably be difficult."
Captain Roa: "...Hmm."
Ymir: "...General Growster doesn't
fully trust us... This is a problem..."
Touya: "? What's wrong?"
Sisk: "Well..."
Sisk: "...And that's what's happened."
Yamato: "I see. He's agreed to a ceasefire,
but says they'll deal with Code 3 themselves...
Though this is exactly when we should be working together."
Derock: "It can't be helped.
I looked at the combat records, and your actions, Touya,
weren't anything to be proud of."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "That's a little harsh.
Besides, it's already happened.
We need to think about what to do now."
Sisk: "Oh! It's His Highness!"
Lodis: "...Please excuse the remote call. He refused
our offer of cooperation after all. They're heading home now,
apparently intending to fight the president."
Ymir: "What?! If they do that..."
Lodis: "The situation is so desperate
that they're willing to take that disgrace upon themselves.
That's how dangerous Code 3 is."
Miyasco: "..."
Celica: "...What will you do, Brother?"
Lodis: "To support their actions,
we'll deploy troops here and pretend we're at a stalemate.
This is no time to worry about which country we're from,
and no time to wage war."
Celica: "...Thank goodness."
Lodis: "?"
Celica: "You're still yourself, Brother.
You hadn't become a despot or a tyrant.
You were only playing the part."
Lodis: "...Touya. Was it you?"
Touya: "N-no! I didn't say anything!"
Celica: "...See?"
Lodis: "! You tricked me..."
Celica: "Hee hee. But I believed in you anyway."
Lodis: "Honestly... A-anyway...
? What is it? ........What?!"
Celica: "What's wrong?"
Lodis: "........Understood.
...Oh, sorry. Some information just came in.
The Great Deilworth Forest lies south of Brandenkrois, Zigrim's capital.
Apparently, there's a Code 3 research facility
a little south of that forest.
Officially, it's a facility for developing
safe, high-quality food, but..."
Celica: "I see. That facility was President Horem's
first national project after he took office, wasn't it?
It was all over the news."
Lodis: "Yes. First, force the public
to pay attention and imprint it on their minds. Then, once they've forgotten,
shift to the real purpose...
Few people willingly pay attention again
to something they've lost interest in.
Especially if it's now commonplace and unremarkable."
Ymir: "If it's true, it's a serious matter.
But if it's wrong, the consequences could be disastrous.
Even people who doubt the war
could suddenly turn against Agarthia.
If that happens..."
Lodis: "Then I'll take responsibility.
If my life will settle it, I'll gladly offer it..."
Celica: "B-Brother?!"
Sisk: "No! You absolutely mustn't!!"
Lodis: "...But it won't come to that.
The information is reliable."
Touya: "You're sure of it."
Lodis: "Yes. The source is First Lieutenant Reamond Dalaim
of the Zigrim Republic Army..."
Yamato: "Reamond... The one who was in that battle earlier..."
Celica: "It's dangerous to trust him unconditionally
just because he's a Zigrim officer. His information itself
could be wrong..."
Miyasco: "...I think it's probably correct."
Celica: "Huh...?"
Miyasco: "Oh, I-I'm sorry.
But, um..."
Touya: "...I think that information's worth trusting too.
Lodis believes it, for one thing.
And you have grounds for it, don't you?"
Lodis: "Yes."
Touya: "Then why not take that chance?
There's no certain path into the future. If there is,
it's only a coward's escape route."
Celica: "...A coward, huh...
Maybe I was thinking of running away.
...Brother. You're really sure this will be all right?"
Lodis: "Yes. Rest knew a fair amount
about Code 3 too. Comparing the information with what he knew
revealed no contradictions. In fact, we judged it highly likely."
Celica: "...All right. Then we'll help too.
You don't mind, do you, Captain?"
Captain Roa: "Of course!"
Celica: "...So that's that.
We'll follow you even if you refuse.
This is no time to worry about countries, is it?"
Lodis: "Heh... You're right.
I'll gratefully accept your offer."
Ymir: "Then we'll bring Liebhofen down to land."
Lodis: "Yes. Thank you for your help."
Miyasco: '...Touya, thank you.'
Touya: 'It's fine. But someday
you should probably tell them properly.'
Miyasco: 'Yes...'
Sisk: "That's right! We've trusted His Highness
all this time, haven't we? Besides, he isn't the sort
to make a careless decision without thinking!"
Celica: "...You're right. This is a worldwide crisis.
Recklessness is out of the question, but maybe I was so concerned
with protecting ourselves that I was thinking of running away...
...Brother. You're really sure this will be all right?"
Lodis: "Yes. Rest knew a fair amount
about Code 3 too. Comparing the information with what he knew
revealed no contradictions. In fact, we judged it highly likely."
Celica: "...All right. Then we'll help too.
You don't mind, do you, Captain?"
Captain Roa: "Of course!"
Celica: "...So that's that.
We'll follow you even if you refuse.
This is no time to worry about countries, is it?"
Lodis: "Heh... You're right.
I'll gratefully accept your offer."
Ymir: "Then we'll bring Liebhofen down to land."
Lodis: "Yes. Thank you for your help."

review_batches.context: Entire member read. Leone's trust hearing, Rosalie's defense, acceptance, children chase and anticipation of Lodis/Growster talks.
review_batches.decisions: Retain suicide/death willingness as fictional dramatic statements without adding methods, doubt versus proven acts, family disclosure secrecy, unconditional trust debate and clipped speech. Selg is distinct from Cell. No invented physical punishment or guaranteed innocence.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00076.l01: Zelbario is named as the means that removed will, according to Ymir's summary; no new device mechanism supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00118.l01: Derock fears future betrayal, not proof Leone will betray again.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00153.l00: Big guy refers to Derock, not a new character name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0018d.l00: Clovis tests readiness to oppose family; preserve difference between persuasion and fighting.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o001f7.l00: Leone honestly doesn't know if she can fight them, then states obligation to stop them.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o001f7.l02: Cost of life remains dramatic willingness, no actionable method added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o001f7.l03: Explicit request/permission to kill her remains source dialogue, not softened into banishment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o002b3.l01: Selg is canonical officer, not Cell. Cornering/harassment context kept without inventing an assault act.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o002b3.l02: No calculation is Rosalie's assessment of Leone's motives, not narrator certainty.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o002b3.l04: Leone tried to consult Touya, not Touya seeking advice from her.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00342.l00: Hangar recollection ties to earlier scene; no new place invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0036a.l00: Trust aphorism is Rosalie's argument, not an absolute empirical claim.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0041f.l00: Fain supports Touya and disputes blame; preserve distinction between being controlled and voluntarily fighting.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o004ae.l01: No lies in tears is Arthur's judgment, not an infallible truth-detection power.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o004ea.l00: Ultimate weapon is Clovis's nonliteral joke, explicitly retracted next.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0053b.l01: Clovis apologizes for doubting, not demands apology from Leone.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00592.l00: Leone's no-it's reply is intentionally incomplete.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o005ae.l01: Secrecy concerns public disclosure for safety, not a new false identity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0064c.l00: Casual yeah self-corrects to polite yes/understood.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o006a2.l00: Sniff is written sob cue translated, not removed.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o006bf.l00: Crybaby is affectionate teasing, without sexualization.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0076a.l01: Once-in-a-while backhanded praise causes Rosalie's reaction; don't omit qualifier.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o007e3.l00: Hear word cuts off as Rosalie proves she can hear.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00838.l00: Gen asks Melvi to run with him, not leave her as a decoy.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o008c1.l00: Rosalie asks Leone for help catching them, not an actual combat deployment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o009c3.l00: About time remains deliberately coy until talks named at 70.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00a37.l00: Sisk uses Highness although others call Lodis king/Majesty. Keep source title usage rather than silently harmonize.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00a37.l04: Sisk eagerly awaits Lodis, not Growster.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00adb.l00: Miyasco teasingly calls Lodis Sisk's beloved; no established marriage or reciprocity claimed.

review_batches.context: Rest's call, Sisk/Lodis reunion, Growster's height joke, Reamond's quiet persuasion and Code 3 introduction.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve Highness/Majesty title usage, both heart cues, short/big wordplay, whispered quote convention, flattery and reported earlier bargain. No actual embrace/kiss mechanism or future marriage invented.

row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00b54.l00: Please is Ymir's deliberate brief operational prompt, answered by incoming Rest call.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00b73.l01: Rest asks crew to prepare; no reverse offering of his own preparation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00ba8.l00: Sisk's disappointment at Rest instead of Lodis is conveyed by silence; no invented thought inserted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00c01.l00: Derock's generalization is character commentary, not factual gender explanation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00d43.l00: Heart glyph retained exactly; no native font support claimed.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00d7a.l00: Second heart retained; scent affection is adult non-graphic romance.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00db4.l00: Celica's name-only command to Derock is deliberately indirect.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00dc9.l00: Effort cue follows assent; exact lift/grip not specified.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00e0d.l00: Derock suggests private affection; no sexual act or completed future encounter invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00e68.l00: Lodis objects to private version too; keep his lack of assent.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o00f44.l00: Ai expected a larger man, not a new height measurement.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o01042.l00: Little things/grow big preserves size versus magnanimity wordplay.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0106a.l00: Punctuation-only outrage retained as nonempty source.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0109c.l00: Single quotes preserve quiet/private persuasion, not a new speaker identity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0109c.l01: Greatness is Reamond's flattery to calm Growster.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o0109c.p01.l01: Questioning generosity/magnanimity, not doubting his literal vessel size.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o012bb.l01: Prior president abandoned plan is Rest's recollection; current agenda remains question.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o01384.l01: Growster recalls Rest's role, not a newly named event.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o013d1.l01: Subjects in Armored Mechs during border duty; no unit count invented here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_01d.o013d1.p01.l01: Agreed to pretend no sighting is explicit suppression bargain, not ordinary forgetting.

review_batches.context: Miyasco/Reamond reveal Code 3 history, abolition and nearly one hundred subjects' deaths; support and urgent assault proposal.
